title: ASUS Dial on Linux
content:
ASUS Dial on Linux

One reason I bought ASUS StudioBook Pro 16 is that it has a dial. And it was my major reason to stick on Windows. However, recently I turned to Linux and I found openwheel which is an open source driver for ASUS dial.

It has no system daemon for it to run at startup. so I added these two systemd services to run it at startup.

Give them udev permissions, edit /etc/udev/rules.d/99-asus-wheel.rules
